description: A small white AirPods charging case and a short white charging cable are lying on a green cloth surface in front of the hands. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the AirPods case as a right-hand object and lift it slightly, while the left hand moves in from the left to pinch and pull the cable’s connector out of the case, unplugging it; then the right hand brings the case back down and releases it onto the cloth while the left hand lets the loose cable end rest nearby.
